title: Insufferable Airport Drunk Refuses To Listen To Police, Goes Away In Cuffs
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 1st, 2023. Officers were called to the airport about a highly intoxicated man causing a scene at the airport after being denied a flight to Seattle. Before the officer's arrival, the man and his wife were originally supposed to go to Puerto Rico, however after a disagreement between them, he got agitated and started yelling and demanding for a flight back to Seattle at the gate agents.  Officers spoke to the man's wife and she wanted nothing to do with him and asked officers to take him to jail due to how he was acting. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
